description.text: Hi! I'm Nick DiRamio! (He/They) I created my series Clip Breakdown so we can dive into the latest movies, TV, and trending videos and look at them clip by clip. I love using my background in film and production and my love of sarcasm and sass to create funny video essays that analyze new movies, nostalgic movies, Disney Channel Originals, Lifetime movies, YouTuber content, low budget music videos, and more!
